name: Infotmic Co.,Ltd
summary: Infotmic Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, design, development, and sale of integrated circuit chips in Mainland China and internationally. It operates through Electronic Components Distribution Business; and Integrated Circuit Design and Sales Business segments. The company offers RF and fingerprint chips, power and storage chips, and passive and comprehensive components for use in mobile phones, network communication equipment, smart devices, automotive electronics, and other industries.
